description: This Java source file defines the class 'DeferredConnectionCheckHandler', which manages deferred connection checks in an asynchronous environment. It handles the state of ongoing connection attempts, accumulates connection check promises during connection attempts, and executes appropriate callbacks upon completion or timeout.

classes.name: DeferredConnectionCheckHandler
classes.description: A handler class that manages deferred connection checks, including queuing checks during ongoing connection attempts and handling their resolution or timeout.

methods.name: DeferredConnectionCheckHandler
methods.description: Constructor, initializes handler with the given Vertx instance.

methods.name: isConnectionAttemptInProgress
methods.description: Checks if a connection attempt is currently ongoing.

methods.name: setConnectionAttemptInProgress
methods.description: Marks that a connection attempt is currently in progress.

methods.name: setConnectionAttemptFinished
methods.description: Marks the current connection attempt as finished, resolving all queued connection checks.

methods.name: addConnectionCheck
methods.description: Adds a connection check with a handler to be invoked upon completion or timeout during an ongoing connection attempt.

methods.name: addToConnectionCheckPromises
methods.description: Helper method to atomically add a new promise to the list of ongoing connection check promises.

methods.name: removeFromConnectionCheckPromises
methods.description: Removes a specific promise from the list of ongoing connection check promises.
